objective: Compile the minimal approved IR to Spine Editor 4.0.64 JSON: one root and child bone, one slot, default skin, region, and rotation animation.
inScope: Exact Spine 4.0.64 minimal JSON research and editor-exported golden fixture
IR-to-Spine adapter, minimal semantic validator, and thin CLI
Golden, invalid-reference, 100-run deterministic, official runtime, and licensed Spine CLI tests
outOfScope: Mesh, weight, IK, other constraints, procedural animation, arbitrary asset placement, AI, MCP, preview, and GUI
changedFiles: fixtures/spine/minimal/input.json, compiled.json, minimal-4.0.64.spine, images, and editor export
implementationSummary: Compiler validates three IR specs and a part-to-bone binding, rejects unsupported shapes, sorts bones parent-first, preserves setup transforms, emits Spine 4.0.64 list-form default skin and rotate timeline value keys, and produces stable JSON. Core remains engine-neutral. CLI only reads input, calls adapter, validates output, and writes JSON.
compatibilityEvidence: Actual licensed Spine Editor 4.0.64 export contains skeleton spine=4.0.64, bones root/child, child length=32 x=8 y=12, slot child-slot -> child/square, default list-form skin, square width=16 height=16, turn animation child rotate keys [{}, {time:1,value:30}].
Golden test compares compiler output with all editor-exported JSON semantics except editor-generated skeleton hash and machine-specific audio path; images path is compared.
Official @esotericsoftware/spine-core 4.0.31 loads compiler output with actual editor-exported atlas and reports 2 bones, 1 slot, 1 animation with duration 1.

Spine CLI 4.0.64 -i compiled.json returned exit 0 and reported 2 bones, 1 slot, 1 animation; import into editable .spine and re-export json+pack returned exit 0, and normalized re-export exactly matched compiled fixture.

checks.name: full verification
checks.evidence: After npm ci --ignore-scripts from package-lock.json, npm run verify passed: Prettier, ESLint, TypeScript build/typecheck, 3 Vitest files and 18 tests. npm audit reported 0 vulnerabilities.

checks.name: golden semantics
checks.evidence: Exact supported structure equals real editor export after excluding hash/audio metadata.

checks.name: determinism
checks.evidence: Same IR compiled and serialized 100 times with identical bytes.

checks.name: negative references
checks.evidence: Unknown bone reference raises SpineCompileError with BONE_REFERENCE validation issue; wrong output version raises VERSION issue.

checks.name: runtime and CLI
checks.evidence: Official 4.0 runtime load and Spine 4.0.64 CLI info/import/re-export succeeded.

checks.name: Gate 0 regression
checks.evidence: All 13 previously approved Gate 0 tests remain in the suite and pass. New regression test proves a pre-Gate-1 AnimationSpec without rotationTimelines still validates under schema ID AnimationSpec-0.1. Eight IR schema contracts, Core facade and package-boundary tests pass. Core has no new dependency; CLI and Spine adapter depend on schemas in the original direction.

knownLimitations: Only one region and one rotation timeline; no arbitrary canvas-to-bone pivot inference.
Official 4.0 runtime package patch differs from editor patch but matches major.minor per Spine versioning guidance.
The golden fixture retains a local audio path written by the editor; compiler output intentionally omits editor-only hash/audio metadata.

definitionOfDone.criterion: Minimal IR compiles without AI and validates
Spine CLI info/import/export round trip passes
